association_evidence.supports: MoMA identifies Musica Viva by Josef Müller-Brockmann, catalogued 1958, as linocut and letterpress, printed by City-Druck AG, Zürich, accession 491.1987. This catalogued date does not explain the 1959 concert date printed in the poster.

The Swiss National Library explains the general postwar International / Swiss Typographic Style and its grid, type and geometric tendencies. This is movement context; the page does not document this particular Musica Viva poster.
